method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Immigration Act 1959 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation in force from 30 September 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/IA1959.txt; with the Immigration Regulations (Rg 1), informal consolidation in force from 1 January 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/IA1959-RG1.txt (reg 6(1), reg 12(1) to (1B), Sixth Schedule items 1 and 2).
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run imm-cases-entry-and-stay.l4 ; l4 run imm-cases-offences.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: SCOPED, from the seat of the non-citizen who comes to, stays in or is sent away from Singapore, and the individual who houses, employs or marries one. imm-entry-and-stay.l4: s 5 (authorised crossing points), ss 6, 7 and 8(2) (who may enter; the s 6(3)(a) sentence), s 8 (prohibited immigrants, class (d)), reg 12(1) to (1B) (visit passes, the exempt prohibited immigrant), s 9 (entry bans), s 9AA (no-boarding directives), s 10 and Sixth Schedule item 1 (permanent residence, $100 + $20), ss 11 and 14A with reg 6(1) (the 180-day re-entry duty, its last day and automatic cancellation, as a regulative rule), Sixth Schedule item 2 ($10 a year or part), s 11A (ceasing to be a citizen), s 12 (endorsing a wife or child), s 14 (cancellation and the s 14(5A) notice), ss 15 and 11A(6) (remaining unlawfully, day 90 and day 91), ss 32, 33, 33A, 35 and 57(3) (removal, 14 days' detention), s 36 (return after removal), ss 39A and 39B (no judicial review except procedure, no hearing), s 58. imm-offences.l4: s 57(1)(d) with (7) to (7D) (harbouring and the two- and three-check due diligence), s 57(1)(e) with (1A), (1B), (8) to (10) (employing), s 57A (work places, $ per offender), s 57C (marriages of convenience, immigration advantage), s 57(1)(k), (ka), (1AAA) (false information), s 59 ($2,000 composition). Not encoded: s 2 beyond terms used, ss 5A to 6A, Part 2A beyond s 9C(1), Part 4, Parts 5A and 5B, other classes of pass, the other s 57 offences, ss 57B and 57D, officers' powers, the prescribed s 57A(5) measures and compoundable offences.
seat: the non-citizen who comes to, stays in or is sent away from Singapore (and the individual who houses, employs or marries one)
